## Checklist

- [ ] Matches `docs/contracts.md` (or the contract change is proposed first)

- [ ] Tests: unit, and integration against live Neo4j/PostgreSQL if graph or proposals code changed

- [ ] No personal paths, accounts, hostnames, tokens or private data
